title: swimcoach status report
description: The body of POST /api/report: a complete picture of one (project, milestone). Every field except needs_me is required, and unknown fields are refused, so a partial or misspelled update fails instead of landing. contract/api.md is the normative text; this schema is its machine-checkable half. The $defs also hold the stop-tracking body and the response bodies of both write routes.

active_hours.description: Total active time spent on the milestone so far, in decimal hours. MAY exceed cap_hours.

cap_hours.description: The milestone's maximum time, in decimal hours. The 168 h ceiling catches minutes or seconds sent by mistake.

agent.description: The agent framework that sent the report.

name.description: Shared rule for project, milestone and needs_me: no whitespace at either end, and no control characters or line breaks anywhere. Whitespace is an explicit set, never an engine's \s or \S, because engines disagree on \s: Python's leaves out U+FEFF, ECMA-262's includes it, and Go's RE2 is ASCII-only. The anchored pattern refuses, at the first and last character, every Unicode White_Space code point plus U+FEFF: U+0009-U+000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000-U+200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000 and U+FEFF, the same set contract/api.md 4.1 lists. The not pattern refuses every C0 control (U+0000-U+001F), U+007F, every C1 control (U+0080-U+009F, so U+0085 NEL too), and the separators U+2028 and U+2029. It is a separate unanchored check because Python's $ also matches before a final newline, and because ECMA-262's . refuses U+2028 and U+2029 where Python's accepts them; once the not pattern removes every character the engines read differently, the anchored pattern's . never meets one. Python and ECMA-262 read the \u escapes as written; an RE2 engine such as Go's needs each one written as \x{...}, with nothing else changed. A sweep of every code point at the start, middle and end of a name gives the same verdicts in all three (contract/README.md).

project.description: The project's stable name, for example "localswim V2" or "FGA". Matched ASCII case-insensitively; see contract/api.md.

milestone.description: The milestone or increment, for example "T06" or "M12". Matched ASCII case-insensitively; see contract/api.md.

laneCount.description: Story cards in one lane for this milestone's epic. The 999 ceiling catches a whole-board count sent by mistake.

lanes.description: Story card count per lane. All five keys are required. Backlog and Blocked are never reported.

needsMe.description: One sentence: what Terry must do. Omit the field when there is no ask; an empty string or null is refused.

epochSeconds.description: A moment as Unix epoch seconds, UTC, with an optional fraction.

stopRequest.description: The body of POST /api/stop: the (project, milestone) to stop tracking.

added.description: True when this report put the (project, milestone) on the board.

sample.description: stored: a new sample was written. duplicate: identical to the newest sample within 60 s, so none was written. none: no sample is defined (total is 0 or active_hours is 0).

errorResponse.description: The body of every JSON error response from the Worker.

message.description: One human-readable sentence, starting with a capital.

problems.description: Present on invalid_report and invalid_stop: one entry per schema violation found.

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the offending value; empty string for the whole body.
